recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered studio portrait of a smiling woman with voluminous dark hair, wearing a white lace-trimmed garment against a soft pink backdrop, framed by bold serif headers and delicate diagonal script.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark hair acts as a central silhouette against the light pink background.
The white lace collar creates a bright horizontal base for the composition.
The top-aligned serif text provides a structural frame for the subject's head.
The diagonal script adds a dynamic, personal touch to the static portrait.
coreInvariants: Soft-focus studio lighting with gentle shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smile and eyes, positioned at the vertical center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold top header, down to the subject's face, then following the diagonal script on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced pink space around the hair and between the text elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dusty rose pink background and garment accents.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black hair and white lace for value range.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan-blue tint in the primary serif typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation background allows the high-value white lace and dark hair to pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif and monolinear script.
letterConstructionRules: Display serif: extremely tight tracking, thin hairlines, and heavy vertical stems.
Script: 45-degree upward diagonal slant, consistent stroke weight, long descenders.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Overlapping characters in the serif header to create a unified block.

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the top of the hair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, heavy serif block with a fluid, airy script.
graphicDevices: Thin underline following the script's diagonal axis.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, condensed serif structure.
Captures the casual, monolinear 80s script feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with 80s-style voluminous curly black hair, smiling warmly, wearing a white lace-trimmed blouse, against a solid dusty rose pink background. Lighting should be soft and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, condensed serif title in cyan blue at the very top with touching letters. Add a white cursive subtitle at a 45-degree angle in the upper left negative space.

verificationChecks: Is the serif text touching or nearly touching?
Is the script angled upwards to the right?
Is the background a consistent pastel pink?
Does the lace have visible detail?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Verify text does not obscure eyes
Confirm the cyan/pink color contrast is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Pastel Backdrop + Top-Heavy Serif + Diagonal Script Overlay
